description: Storage + grading layer: add AFL by-scope computer and stored shape, make the single grader gradeOverlapScoped route player_accuracy by sport across all five call sites, and widen the stored type to a discriminated union. This is the lower layer FEAT-002 depends on (it exports StoredAflPlayerAccuracy and the union used by the page). Includes all unit tests for this layer. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 consumes its exported types.
steps: In lib/comparison/afl-player-accuracy.ts add `export type StoredAflPlayerAccuracy = { afl: true; both: AflPlayerAccuracy; home: AflPlayerAccuracy; away: AflPlayerAccuracy }` and `export function computeAflPlayerAccuracyByScope(masterInstances, analystInstances, tolerance, masterFileName?)`. Mirror computePlayerAccuracyByScope in lib/comparison/player-accuracy.ts EXACTLY: import canonicaliseTeams, compareInstances, type Instance from ./xml-compare and type PlayerAccuracyScope from ./player-accuracy; canonicalise, then for each scope (both/home/away) filter in-scope instances, compareInstances, and run computeAflPlayerAccuracy on cmp.rows. Return { afl: true, both, home, away } with `afl` as literal true.

In lib/comparison/afl-player-accuracy.test.ts extend tests: (a) computeAflPlayerAccuracyByScope returns { afl:true, both, home, away } each an AflPlayerAccuracy (assert group keys overall/scoring/defence/possession/disposals/other present); (b) its `both` scope deep-equals computeAflPlayerAccuracy over the same both-scoped comparison rows. Reuse existing inst/row/exactRows helpers; build small master + analyst Instance[] with Home/Away teams so home/away scoping is exercised. Add a routing-shape test asserting an AFL stored result carries `afl:true` with scoring/defence/possession/disposals groups while a football stored result (computePlayerAccuracyByScope) carries `football` with passing/offensive/defensive/goalkeeper groups.

In lib/api/accuracyChecks.ts import computeAflPlayerAccuracyByScope and type StoredAflPlayerAccuracy from @/lib/comparison/afl-player-accuracy. Add a trailing `sport: string | null | undefined` parameter to gradeOverlapScoped; widen its return `playerAccuracy` to `StoredPlayerAccuracy | StoredAflPlayerAccuracy`; when sport === 'afl' compute playerAccuracy via computeAflPlayerAccuracyByScope(scoped.master, scoped.analyst, tol, name) else via computePlayerAccuracyByScope (unchanged). Leave result (summary/byCategory/byTeam) computed identically for both. Document that null/unknown sport keeps football (safe default).

Update the five gradeOverlapScoped call sites in lib/api/accuracyChecks.ts to pass sport: saveAccuracyCheck -> input.sport; updateAccuracyCheck -> input.sport, and in its defensive recovery branch add `sport` to the `.select('xml_analyst, file_name_master, tolerance')` and pass the stored sport; propagateMasterCorrection -> add `sport` to its `.select('id, analyst_name, tolerance, xml_analyst, file_name_master')` and the row type, pass row.sport; backfillPlayerAccuracy -> add `sport` to the id-list `.select('id, tolerance, file_name_master')` and the rows type, pass row.sport; mergeMasters -> add `sport` to the destination-group reload `.select('id, analyst_name, tolerance, xml_analyst, file_name_master')` and the row type, pass row.sport.

Update the stored TYPE in lib/api/accuracyChecks.ts: change AccuracyCheck.player_accuracy to `StoredPlayerAccuracy | StoredAflPlayerAccuracy | null` (import StoredAflPlayerAccuracy). AccuracyCheckMeta = Omit<AccuracyCheck,'xml_master'|'xml_analyst'> inherits it. ACCURACY_CHECK_META_COLUMNS already includes player_accuracy and sport — confirm, no column change.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest --run lib/comparison/afl-player-accuracy.test.ts` passes, including the new by-scope and routing-shape tests, and the existing 16 tests still pass.
`npx tsc --noEmit` is clean with the widened gradeOverlapScoped return type and player_accuracy union.

gradeOverlapScoped stores an AFL-shaped player_accuracy ({afl:true, scoring/defence/possession/disposals/other groups}) when sport==='afl' and a football-shaped one ({football,...}) for 'football'/null, verified by the routing-shape test.
All five call sites compile and pass sport (SELECTs include the sport column where the row is read from the DB).
findings:
DONE. All verification green: `npx vitest --run lib/comparison/afl-player-accuracy.test.ts` = 19 passed (16 original + 3 new: by-scope shape, both-scope deep-equal, routing-shape AFL-vs-football); `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npm run test` = 168 passed across 13 files. NOTE: `npm run lint` has a PRE-EXISTING broken baseline (286 problems project-wide, incl. getSavedMasters `(row as any)` casts at accuracyChecks.ts:1374-1406 that I did NOT touch); not in FEAT-001's verification list. My edits introduce no new lint errors.

=== EXPORTED TYPES / LOCATIONS FOR FEAT-002 ===
From `@/lib/comparison/afl-player-accuracy`:
  - type `StoredAflPlayerAccuracy = { afl: true; both: AflPlayerAccuracy; home: AflPlayerAccuracy; away: AflPlayerAccuracy }` (DISCRIMINANT is the literal `afl: true`; it has NO `football` key).
  - type `AflPlayerAccuracy = { overall; scoring; defence; possession; disposals; other }` (each an `AccuracyGroup`).
  - `AFL_GROUPS` (scoring/defence/possession/disposals/other, sizes 9/8/7/11/11) for building the AFL column list; each part is { key, label }. Group labels: Scoring/Defence/Possession/Disposals/Other.
  - `computeAflPlayerAccuracyByScope(master: Instance[], analyst: Instance[], tolerance: number, masterFileName?: string|null): StoredAflPlayerAccuracy` (fallback raw-XML compute, mirrors computePlayerAccuracyByScope).
  - `computeAflPlayerAccuracy(rows: ComparisonRow[]): AflPlayerAccuracy`.
From `@/lib/comparison/player-accuracy` (unchanged): `StoredPlayerAccuracy` has `football: boolean`, groups overall/passing/offensive/defensive/goalkeeper/other.

=== SHAPE DETECTION (per-row reader) ===
The stored union is `StoredPlayerAccuracy | StoredAflPlayerAccuracy | null` on `AccuracyCheck.player_accuracy` (and inherited by `AccuracyCheckMeta`). DISCRIMINATE ON THE STORED SHAPE, not the `sport` column (legacy AFL rows may still carry a football value). Narrow with `"afl" in pa` => AFL, else `"football" in pa` => football.

=== TEMP SHIM IN app/accuracy-checks/page.tsx (FEAT-002 MUST address) ===
To keep `tsc` clean under the widened union WITHOUT doing FEAT-002's AFL rendering, I added a minimal narrowing helper `asFootballStored(pa): StoredPlayerAccuracy | null` (returns pa only when `"football" in pa`) and applied it at the THREE football-only readers: `fixtureGroupAccuracy` (~line 150), `storedGroupPct` (~line 234), and the per-analyst stat aggregation loop (~line 768, var `pa` from `c.player_accuracy`). Behavior is UNCHANGED for football and AFL-shaped values still read as "no football data" (same as the old `!stored.football`). FEAT-002 should replace/extend these with real AFL-aware rendering (AFL columns from AFL_GROUPS, `storedGroupPct` reading AFL groups, etc.) and can drop the shim where it adds true union handling. New imports added to page.tsx: `StoredPlayerAccuracy` from player-accuracy and `StoredAflPlayerAccuracy` from afl-player-accuracy.

=== GRADER SIGNATURE (lib/api/accuracyChecks.ts, module-private) ===
`gradeOverlapScoped(xmlMaster, xmlAnalyst, tolerance, fileNameMaster, sport: string|null|undefined): { result: ComparisonResult; playerAccuracy: StoredPlayerAccuracy | StoredAflPlayerAccuracy } | null`. Routes playerAccuracy via computeAflPlayerAccuracyByScope when `sport === 'afl'`, else computePlayerAccuracyByScope (football is the safe default for null/unknown). All FIVE call sites now pass sport and SELECT the `sport` column where reading from DB: saveAccuracyCheck(input.sport), updateAccuracyCheck(input.sport; recovery branch selects+passes stored sport with input.sport winning when provided), propagateMasterCorrection(row.sport), backfillPlayerAccuracy/recomputeAllPlayerAccuracy(row.sport), mergeMasters(row.sport). ACCURACY_CHECK_META_COLUMNS already includes player_accuracy and sport (confirmed, no column change).
